package.name: mongla_runtime
package.description: How every Mongla process runs, and nothing else: the executor and its clean Ctrl-C, dying with the parent, the bringup.yaml parameters and launch defaults, the restart policy, and the realtime priority. It imports nothing from Mongla, so every node package can depend on it without a cycle. It used to live in mongla_localization, which made vision, the manager and Batighor depend on the estimator for their plumbing.
